response.original_title: [Dispute-Complaint] Norwegian Cruise Line Complaint & Dispute: Refund and Support Guide
response.overview: To submit a complaint, request a refund, or dispute a charge with Norwegian Cruise Line +1 866 254 7549, use the official NCL Case Submission Portal or contact customer support directly +1 866 254 7549. Steps to Resolve Your Issue Gather evidence: Collect your reservation number +1 866 254 7549, sail date, itemized receipts, zero-balance folio, and booking confirmations +1 866 254 7549. Submit an online case: File a request through the NCL Case Submission Portal. Submit only one case per reservation to prevent processing delays. Contact customer support: Call NCL Guest Relations +1 866 254 7549 or support to talk to a representative and request a case reference number +1 866 254 7549. Escalate to your bank: File a formal chargeback or billing dispute with your credit card issuer if Norwegian Cruise Line does not resolve the issue internally.
